Our Services

Full service pest control, inside and out

From the living room to the lawn, we handle the pests Titusville homes and businesses actually deal with — and we do our own fumigations, in house.

Interior Pest Control

Safe, thorough interior treatments that protect your family’s living spaces — including homes with kids and pets.

Lawns & Shrubbery

Lawn and shrubbery treatments that keep your yard healthy and pest-free, season after season.

Termite Control

Termite inspection and treatment that protects the structure of your home before damage spreads.

Bed Bug Treatment

Tent Fumigation

About Tom & Jerry's

Three decades of pest control, one local family

Tom & Jerry’s Pest Control has been locally owned and operated for over 30 years. Owner Jerry Lamb has been in the pest control business since 1975, starting his own company (Tom & Jerry’s) in 1980.

  • We do it allHomes, businesses, termites — and our own fumigations for termites, beetles, and bed bugs.
  • Eco-wise approachThoughtful treatments that protect your home, your family, and your pets.
  • Locally owned since 1980A Titusville company, not a national chain — we know Florida pests.
  • Full serviceInterior pest control, lawns and shrubbery, termites, bed bugs, and tent fumigation.
